business_summary: Fuxin Dare Automotive Parts Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of automotive parts systems in China and internationally. It operates through Pumps and Electronics Products; Noise Reduction, Heat Insulation and Lightweight Products, and Automotive Interior Products segments. The company offers noise reduction (NHV), thermal, and lightweight products comprising interior solutions consisting of air ducts, dash inner, roof reinforcements, I/P lower panels, door water shields, and rear shelves; exterior solutions, including underbody panels, NVH tunnels, tank insulators and brackets, brake shields, and retaining straps; powertrain solutions, such as engine top covers, battery and dash insulation, thermal shield turbochargers, sound insulation hoods, close to engine encapsulation, and encapsulation refrigerating compressors; and new energy vehicles solutions, which include motor encapsulation, insulation main floor, encapsulation of electric refrigerating compressors, and battery cover foils and shields. It also provides electric pumps and motors, and mechanical pumps, such as hydraulic steering and electro-hydraulic steering pumps, hydraulic retarders, electronic oil and electronic duplex pumps, brushless DC motors, and clutch shift motors for use in automotive steering, transmission, and braking systems; electronic control and automotive electronic products consisting of actuator motors, seat, body, electro-hydraulic steering pumps, and transmission electronic pump controllers, as well as body electronics; commercial vehicle auxiliary braking products; and new energy reserve products, such as solid-state batteries, membrane electrodes, and hydrogen dispensers. In addition, the company engages in business management; and real estate leasing and management activities. Fuxin Dare Automotive Parts Co., Ltd. was founded in 2004 and is based in Fuxin, China.
business_summary_ko: Fuxin Dare Automotive Parts Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 중국 및 국제적으로 자동차 부품 시스템의 연구, 개발, 제조 및 판매에 참여하고 있습니다. 펌프 및 전자 제품을 통해 운영됩니다. 소음 감소, 단열 및 경량 제품, 자동차 내장 제품 부문. 이 회사는 공기 덕트, 대시 내부, 지붕 보강재, I/P 하부 패널, 도어 워터 쉴드 및 후면 선반으로 구성된 내부 솔루션으로 구성된 소음 감소(NHV), 열 및 경량 제품을 제공합니다. 차체 하부 패널, NVH 터널, 탱크 절연체 및 브래킷, 브레이크 실드, 고정 스트랩을 포함한 외부 솔루션; 엔진 상단 커버, 배터리 및 대시 단열재, 열 차폐 터보차저, 방음 후드, 엔진 캡슐화 및 캡슐화 냉동 압축기와 같은 파워트레인 솔루션; 모터 캡슐화, 절연 메인 플로어, 전기 냉동 압축기의 캡슐화, 배터리 커버 포일 및 실드를 포함하는 신에너지 차량 솔루션. 또한 전동펌프 및 모터, 유압조향, 전동유압스테 등 기계식 펌프도 공급하고 있습니다.
